$comment: Closed records for the normative extensions this corpus defines. `maturity` is
one of experimental|draft|stable|deprecated, and §C sets a hard bar for stable:
normative prose, schemas, non-vacuous conformance, SDK support where applicable,
and at least one Tier-3 implementation.
This registry is NOT complete for the whole corpus. It covers the extensions the
RFC 0147 program introduces or names, backfilled from each RFC's own status and
its landed/carried annotations. Extensions predating the program are unlisted,
and unlisted means UNCOVERED rather than compliant — the same distinction
RFC 0148 §C drew between an empty floor and an unwritten one.
NOTE: every record here is at most `draft`. §C gates `stable` on a Tier-3
implementation, and no Tier-3 host exists — the `ROADMAP.md` tripwire has not
fired. That ceiling is a fact about adoption, not about the maturity of the work,
and the registry states it instead of quietly promoting anything.

coverage.rule: Derived by scripts/generate-extension-registry-coverage.mjs from the top-level keys of schemas/capabilities.schema.json. coreFields = the openwop-discovery-core predicate fields (profiles.md), covered = families reached by some record capabilityPath, uncovered = every other family. Uncovered means no registry record exists — not that the family is non-compliant. Regenerate with --write; the gate runs --check.

extensions.note: RFC 0151 `Accepted`; shape landed at suite 1.89.0 (`b4796755`), the six §D events (`76195069`), the capability-gated behavioral witness `compensation-behavior.test.ts` at 1.94.0 (`4bec9e07`), and `compensationStatus` on `RunSnapshot` + `spec/v1/compensation.md` (`Draft`, landed subset only) + seams §21 at 1.107.0 (`5f1978f2`). `draft`, not `stable`: no host advertises `compensation.supported`, so every behavioral leg resolves to `blocked` (RFC 0148 §A); §C/§E prose and `compensation-policy.schema.json` remain carried.

RFC 0152 `Accepted`; discovery shape (`3ce1c04b`), the §B negotiation witness `a2a-version-negotiation.test.ts` at 1.96.0 (`5f1a7112`), and — 2026-08-16 — the 1.0 profile prose and field-by-field translation table in `spec/v1/a2a-integration.md` §"A2A 1.0 versioned composition" (`d77d259b`, pinned to A2A 1.0.0; JSON-RPC-at-1.0 floor; `a2a-0.3-legacy` named and time-bounded to 2027-03-12) landed; openwop-app's live origin advertises `a2a.protocolVersions` and passes the §A leg; it has not wired the invoke seam, so the §B legs are `blocked` there (corrected 2026-08-16). `draft`: the suite's fake peer is 0.3-shaped so §C/§D are unwitnessed at 1.0, and stable is additionally blocked on a real upstream A2A 1.0 peer, which is not a corpus deliverable. **`capabilityPath` corrected 2026-08-13** from `a2a.protocolVersion` — it did not resolve against `capabilities.schema.json`.

RFC 0153 `Accepted`; discovery shape (`3ce1c04b`), the §A/§B revision-negotiation witness `mcp-version-negotiation.test.ts` at 1.97.0 (`7b09e9aa`), and — 2026-08-16 — the profile prose and MRTR mapping in `spec/v1/mcp-integration.md` §"MCP 2026-07-28 versioned composition" (`65ebd53a`, pinned to the upstream 2026-07-28 revision; `mcp-2025-06-18-legacy` named and time-bounded to 2027-08-12) landed; openwop-app's live origin advertises `mcp.protocolVersions` and passes the §A legs; the §B legs are `blocked` there (no invoke seam). `draft`: the suite's fake server speaks the 2025-06-18 handshake so §B stateless rules, `server/discover`, MRTR, and cache hints are unwitnessed, and stable is additionally gated on a pinned upstream peer at the current revision. **`capabilityPath` corrected 2026-08-13** from `mcp.protocolVersion` — it did not resolve against `capabilities.schema.json`.

RFC 0154 `Accepted`; `workload-identity.schema.json` + `auth.workloadIdentity` (`8de95a14`), the behavioral witness `workload-identity-behavior.test.ts` + seam §20 at 1.95.0 (`f27765cd`), per-section gating (`b7c52f75`), and — 2026-08-16 — the auth prose (`spec/v1/auth.md` §"Workload identity and delegated actor chain"), the OTel mapping (`observability.md`, v0 experimental `gen_ai.*` projection), and `SECURITY/threat-model-workload-identity.md` (`31de3bbb`) landed. `draft`: no host advertises `auth.workloadIdentity` (legs resolve to `blocked`), six §F invariants are named-but-unregistered, and the provenance half spans `openwop-sdks` and `openwop-registry`, so it cannot reach stable from this repo alone. **`capabilityPath` corrected 2026-08-13** from `workloadIdentity.supported` — it did not resolve against `capabilities.schema.json`.

RFC 0150 §B/§C/§D landed with normative prose, conformance, invariants, and golden vectors — the richest evidence any extension here has. Still `draft`, not `stable`: §C requires at least one Tier-3 implementation for stable, and none exists. **No extension in this corpus can currently reach `stable` for that reason**, which is a fact about adoption rather than about the work, and is recorded here rather than worked around.
RFC 0150 §D vocabulary landed, but no host implements fencing and the witness is corpus-structural (gap G10).
